hook: Your rain gauge here would never stay empty.
title: Your Rain Gauge Overflows in Meghalaya
description:
Mawsynram in Meghalaya, India is among the wettest places on Earth. Monsoon clouds hit the Khasi Hills and dump rain on this village. Locals even wear bamboo rain shields called knups.

#Shorts #Meghalaya #Geography
